notes: P3-S0 Weapon Lab archetype params — the RESIDUAL, reviewed decisions. Everything derivable is computed by pipeline/merge/labParams.ts (its header is the tooling doc): family = the wiki category of the weapon article; classification from Module:Iteminfo/data useStyle (quoted from the Use Style IDs article), class, noMelee, channel, shoot, useAmmo, mana; swing reach/arc, magic-bolt velocity/pierce, bow-gun ammo class derived; single-projectile / no-spread / ammo-unchanged defaults only when the article screen is clean.

PARAM SEMANTICS (AMENDMENTS-008 B37, binding — see src/sim/README.md 'Cadence' and 'Open questions' #2): pierce = extra dummies passed through AFTER the first hit (0 = stops at the first); projectilesPerUse = projectiles per activation (shot) within one attack — bursts come from useTime < useAnimation, never from projectilesPerUse; an ammo projectile's speed comes only from the ammo's velocityBonusTps / velocityMultiplier (bow-gun entries carry no speed); magic-bolt speed = params.projectile.velocityTps (derived from Iteminfo shootSpeed x (1 + Projectileinfo extraUpdates)), never weapon.shootSpeedTps.

An entry exists only for a weapon the article screen flagged (the build fails on an entry for a clean weapon — residuals only). decision 'archetype': a reviewer read the article and confirms the archetype fits; residual values (projectilesPerUse, spreadDegrees, inheritsAmmoProjectile, pierce, lifetimeTicks) must each be stated by one of the quotes (number / number word, degrees, pierce wording, seconds) — checked by the build. decision 'limitation': `reason` is emitted on the Lab's limitation card; the quotes document the behavior the params cannot express.

Every quote is checked verbatim against the cached revision of the cited article; the weapon's own article must be cited. `why` is pipeline-only reviewer rationale. NEVER guess: a weapon whose behavior the wiki does not pin down stays a limitation (e.g. guns whose spread angle is unstated, homing whose strength is undocumented, thrust reach).

entries.reason: It is a held weapon that fires inaccurately and adds homing explosive rockets — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it very rapidly fires bullets with inaccurate spread.

entries.name: Phantasm
entries.reason: It is a held bow that fires bursts that speed up over time and spawn homing arrows on hit — not modeled.

evidence.quote: Its fire rate will gradually increase while in use.

entries.name: Lunar Flare
entries.reason: Its flares rain down toward the cursor and explode — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it summons a spread of three lunar flares that rain down towards the cursor.

entries.name: Mandible Blade

evidence.quote: The Mandible Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword
while swinging will throw the weapon in direction of the cursor

entries.why: The throw happens only when the attack is released mid-swing; the Lab holds the attack (labeled auto-reuse assumption), so every use is a swing.

entries.name: Onyx Blaster
entries.reason: It fires a spread of bullets plus an exploding crystal (200% damage) — not modeled.

evidence.quote: It also fires an onyx crystal that explodes upon impact with an enemy or a block, or after traveling for 0.33 seconds.

entries.name: Brand of the Inferno
entries.reason: It has a 25% chance to inflict Hellfire (damage over time) on hit and a shield parry that boosts the next attack — not modeled.

evidence.quote: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance of inflicting the Hellfire debuff for five seconds on hit

entries.name: Flying Dragon
entries.reason: Swings fire piercing crescent projectiles every 20 ticks — not modeled by the swing parameters.

evidence.quote: When swung, it fires red crescent-shaped projectiles every 20 ticks
which pierce four enemies, pass through blocks, and dissipate after one second.

entries.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
entries.reason: It fires bursts of pages and has a tornado secondary attack — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used with ⚒ Use / Attack, it fires bursts of four high-velocity pages that dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks.

entries.name: Phantom Phoenix
entries.reason: It is a held bow that fires two spread arrows and a Phoenix (200% damage) every third use — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it fires a slight spread of two arrows, alongside a large Phoenix projectile on every third use.

entries.name: Aerial Bane
entries.reason: It converts every arrow into splitting, exploding arrows — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it converts any type of arrow into Aerial Bane arrows.

entries.name: Skull Bow
entries.reason: It converts Bone Arrows into the Marrow's Bone Arrows — an ammo conversion the Lab does not model.

evidence.quote: it can convert Bone Arrows (ID 474) into Bone Arrows from the Marrow (ID 117).

entries.name: Thunder Zapper
entries.reason: Its lightning bolt travels in a zigzag — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally

entries.name: Gray Zapinator
entries.reason: Its laser behaves erratically with random effects — not modeled.

evidence.quote: The weapon fires a blue laser beam that behaves very erratically.

entries.name: Orange Zapinator
entries.reason: Its laser behaves erratically with random effects — not modeled.

evidence.quote: The weapon fires a blue laser beam that behaves very erratically.

entries.name: Blood Rain Bow
entries.reason: Its arrows become streams of blood raining from the sky — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it converts any type of arrow into a spread of 1–3 streams of blood
to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor.

entries.name: Quad-Barrel Shotgun

evidence.quote: When used, it fires eight bullets at a 45° spread, consuming one piece of ammunition.

entries.why: Eight bullets over a stated 45° spread; how the bullets are distributed inside it is the sim's labeled even-fan approximation.

entries.name: Eventide
entries.reason: It fires bursts of arrows plus a Twilight Lance (200% damage) — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it fires a burst of four arrows and one Twilight Lance projectile

entries.name: Resonance Scepter
entries.reason: It creates damaging auras at the cursor — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it creates pink circular auras at the cursor's location

entries.name: Tentacle Spike
entries.reason: Hits embed stacking spikes that deal damage over time — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When swung, it sticks tentacle spikes into enemies on hit, which linger on the enemy and deal 3 damage per second for 9 seconds.

entries.name: Ham Bat
entries.reason: Its damage is multiplied while the player has a food buff — not modeled by the Lab.

evidence.quote: While the player has a food buff, the Ham Bat receives a damage multiplier, which scales with tier of the food buff.

entries.name: Bat Bat

evidence.quote: When swung, it restores 1 health to the user upon hitting an enemy.

entries.why: Healing the player does not change the damage dealt.

entries.name: Pew-matic Horn
entries.reason: It converts bullets into random items whose damage varies — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it converts any bullet into a randomized item fired as a projectile.

entries.name: Weather Pain
entries.reason: Its Hurtnado homes in and hovers to deal continuous damage — not modeled.

evidence.quote: The Hurtnado has 10 armor penetration, bounces off blocks, and homes in on nearby enemies

entries.name: Flymeal

evidence.quote: Like the Classy Cane, it has the special ability to attack town NPCs.
It also inflicts the Stinky debuff for 5 seconds.

entries.why: The 2x / defense-ignoring damage applies to town NPCs (not Target Dummies); Stinky deals no damage over time.

entries.name: Wand of Frosting
entries.reason: Its spark curves, pierces once and can inflict Frostburn — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When used, it fires a blue spark that travels in a slight curve for about 23 tiles before dissipating.

entries.name: Ash Wood Bow

evidence.quote: The Ash Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.
In the Remix and Zenith seeds, the Ash Wood Bow receives the following changes

entries.why: The stat decrease applies only in the Remix/Zenith seeds.

entries.name: Ash Wood Sword

evidence.quote: The Ash Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.
In the Remix and Zenith seeds, the Ash Wood Sword receives the following changes

entries.why: The stat decrease applies only in the Remix/Zenith seeds; the dataset carries the normal-world stats.

entries.name: Waffle's Iron
entries.reason: Swings fire a gravity-affected waffle, and hits can inflict Hellfire (damage over time) — not modeled.

evidence.quote: When swung, it fires a waffle projectile once per swing, which is significantly affected by gravity.

entries.name: Daybloom Staff
entries.reason: It fires a short-ranged burst of slowing pellets with slight inaccuracy — not modeled.

evidence.quote: fires a short-ranged burst of 4 non-piercing yellow pellets toward the cursor with slight inaccuracy

entries.name: Glacier Fang
entries.reason: Its icicles are charged by holding the attack and fall with gravity — not modeled.

evidence.quote: The Glacier Fang is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires chargeable icicles toward the cursor, affected by gravity.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.reason: Its spark calls down a lightning bolt from the sky — not modeled.

evidence.quote: It fires a spark that attaches itself to an enemy and calls down a lightning bolt from the sky to its location shortly after.
